T1_irreducible_face.statement: Two systems can have identical vertices/edges yet differ by presence of the 2-simplex face; whole-system relational information is not reducible to pairwise boundary data.

T2_r65_cover_correction.statement: The three boundary edges cover ∂Δ², not the filled 2-simplex Δ². Therefore failure to reconstruct face-interior/global data from edge data is not, by itself, a failure of the sheaf axiom on a valid cover of Δ².

T3_cellular_resolution.statement: Resolution naturally attaches to cells/simplices of multiple orders; higher-order system Resolution can live on higher cells while restricting to lower cells.

T4_four_ball_dimensional_audit.statement: A generic four-point Euclidean relational configuration already has 6 shape/separation degrees of freedom modulo rigid motion, before Resolution/History. Thus the R64 three-ball 5D chart cannot generalize as a universal system configuration chart.

T5_ambient_vs_configuration_resolution.statement: A 5D ambient/event carrier is compatible with arbitrarily high-dimensional N-object configuration/moduli spaces; system information is represented as tuples/sections over M5 rather than by forcing all system degrees into one 5D coordinate chart.

T6_higher_order_global.statement: For four objects, identical vertex/edge/face boundary data can still differ by presence of the 3-simplex, so irreducible global Resolution repeats at higher simplex order.

T7_rainbow_section_transport.statement: Rainbow Road can transport cellular/simplicial Resolution sections under Bandwidth-admissible partial morphisms while Vera retains the ordered path word.
